rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when one change or amount matches another in degree.

example.english: After the pay raise, the workload increased commensurately.
example.traditional: 加人工之後，工作量都相應咁增加。
example.jyutping: gaa1 jan4 gung1 zi1 hau6 gung1 zok3 loeng6 dou1 soeng1 jing3 gam3 zang1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this when the matching change is specifically calculated in proportion.

example.english: The rent went up, and the management fee was adjusted commensurately.
example.traditional: 租金加咗，管理費都按比例咁上調。
example.jyutping: zou1 gam1 gaa1 zo2 gun2 lei5 fai3 dou1 on3 bei2 lai6 gam3 soeng6 tiu4

rows.note: Use this when separate people or things receive or have an equal amount.

example.english: The two children received commensurately equal amounts of candy.
example.traditional: 兩個小朋友分到一樣咁多糖。
example.jyutping: loeng5 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 fan1 dou3 jat1 joeng6 gam3 do1 tong4
